title: eval-harness: add per-prompt regression CI hook with thresholded gating
author: Lin Chen
description:
Context: We want faster feedback on prompt-level regressions for model rollouts and PRs that touch prompt sets. Previously the eval-harness ran nightly and on request; teams had to triage regressions after the fact. This PR introduces a GitHub Actions CI hook that runs a lightweight per-prompt evaluation for changed prompt-sets and fails the PR if any prompt exceeds configured regression thresholds.

Motivation: catch quality regressions earlier in the dev cycle, provide deterministic per-prompt metrics in PRs, and enable automated gating for sensitive prompt sets.

What I changed (high level): - New GH Action workflow: .github/workflows/eval-per-prompt-ci.yml that detects changed prompt files and runs eval-harness with a per-prompt config. - eval-harness: add CLI flag --per-prompt-ci and a small runner that computes delta vs baseline metrics, compares against thresholds, and exits non-zero when gates are violated. - config: add .eval/per-prompt-ci-config.yaml with default thresholds and allow repo overrides. - tests: unit tests for the threshold comparator and an integration test that runs a subset of prompts (fast fixtures). - docs: docs/eval/per-prompt-ci.md describing behavior and how to opt-out for very large PRs.

Implementation notes: - The comparator uses z-score + absolute-delta thresholds (configurable) to avoid over-sensitivity on low-volume prompts. - Baselines are pulled from the eval-metrics API (cached locally in CI runner); when a baseline is missing the prompt is marked INFO and does not fail CI. - The GH Action posts a summary comment with per-prompt metric deltas and links to the full eval report stored as an artifact.

Testing notes: included unit tests and a small integration job that runs in ~3m on CI. I added retries around flaky integration steps and a fixture to simulate baseline pulls.

Checklist:
- [x] Implement core runner and CLI flag
- [x] Add GH Action workflow and conditional trigger
- [x] Add config and docs
- [x] Unit + integration tests
- [x] Add reviewers and address feedback

Related: Linear ENG-2874, ENG-2950. See also PR #314159 for eval-metrics ingestion changes.

Lin Chen: Added PR-size check to the workflow (skip if changed_files > 500) and added exponential backoff to baseline fetch. PTAL.
Diego Morales: Left a nit on comparator naming and suggested adding a small example in docs. Approve after those fixes.
Lin Chen: Addressed naming nits and added example table to docs. Thanks!
Sophie Nguyen: Integration rerun looked good. Approving — happy to see per-prompt visibility in PRs.
release_notes: Add per-prompt CI gating: new lightweight GH Action that runs eval-harness per changed prompt set and fails PRs when configured thresholds are exceeded. Configuration lives in .eval/per-prompt-ci-config.yaml.
